status: construction input; not finished art, runtime rig, or collision PASS

source.note: Updated art director source: narrowed packed soles, packed head rotated -25 degrees, 0/24/10 carriage strokes. Arm and thorax lengths/contours are unchanged. Gate geometry, depth sub-bands and arm release hold remain asset construction refinements.

coordinates.unit: raw unit of art director packing_diagram.py
coordinates.angles: degrees counterclockwise from +x, absolute in study poses
coordinates.exportY: invert y for down-positive sprite coordinates; transform attachments with the same operation

thorax.eyeParent: head carriage anchored at thorax.upper.end; one head/eye chain

raptorial.stem: shoulder fork at upper root; no new independent shoulder translation

jointCaps.note: Blade free tip circle in source is a diagram marker, not a new joint or metal disc

walking.assetRefinement: Current art director revision narrowed packed soles: outer x = +/-89 fits shell +/-90. Foot has its own ankle; no required corrective scaling or bone length change. Deployment and floor clearance are still to be checked.

opticalCarriage.note: Separate front shell hatch stays on shell. Head brow remains on head. Carriage/eye parent does not change between states.

mantisStudy.note: Two arms coincide in strict side projection of study. Final three-quarter view and joint poses must separate their silhouettes.

depthBudgets.note: Asset thickness budget, not z-index. Pins/forks intentionally bridge parent and child slabs only around their joint axes. Caps and relief must remain within budget.

raptorial.metalDoorOutline: intersection of this rectangle with shell XY outline; opening continues through upper silhouette
raptorial.hingeAxis: parallel to x at y=35, on outer side wall z=+/-51
raptorial.opening: rotate outward about x, to 100 degrees or greater before thorax starts; motion goes outside z=+/-51, away from stored arm volumes
raptorial.depth: one real side hatch per arm lane, both continuous with open dorsal exit
raptorial.close: only after closed arm package is above shell; shell mass stays attached and returns to abdomen

eye.openingNote: Iris diameter alone does not admit whole head. A separate front shell hatch opens the head-frame exit rectangle, clipped to actual shell wall, before packed head turns and carriage extends. Recheck entire head/hood volume in three-quarter view.
eye.boundsScope: Independent head angle anywhere in [-25,0] and carriage stroke anywhere in [0,24]; rigid polygon extrema at interval endpoints/stationary angles. Lens circle is smaller than these bounds. Final thickness and hatch swept volume remain separate checks.

walking.note: One actual lower rail port for each front/rear, near/far pocket. Exact exit path and floor clearance are not resolved by the static art director diagram; validate the four full solids before locking slot outlines.

assumptions: Both arm-side gates open outward first
Their upper roof opening is continuous
Forearm shape remains closed at absolute angles 0 and 170 until clear
Thorax lower angle moves from 170 toward 131.850... without any link scaling
Upper link and head pose are separately solved by Builder; this arm study does not certify their collision path

armClearanceTrigger.reason: At y=105, lowest closed forearm contour is y=94; fixed shell max roof is y=90. Keep at least 4 raw units before beginning large forearm unfold.

releaseStudy.scope: Complete closed arm polygons fit a convex open release column by endpoint bounds; staged rigid arm opening clears fixed roof by the stated 2D bounds. Final relief, finite door thickness, shoulder axle, upper thorax/head/legs and full-creature swept-solid QA remain unverified.

continuousClosedArmXYBound.reason: During 170 -> 131.849664855 deg, shoulder x and y are monotonic; held arm orientations are constant, so coordinate extrema occur at interval endpoints. Bound covers full polygon interiors inside the convex release column.
continuousClosedArmXYBound.includes: Both rigid contour polygons plus radius-5 shoulder/elbow caps; final relief beyond this study is not included

followingArmPhases.proof: Closed local arm contour rotated as a rigid composite over 0..60 degrees; extrema at endpoints/stationary angles. Radius-5 shoulder/elbow caps stay above y=100.

followingArmPhases.reason: Any blade orientation stays inside radius max(local vertex norm) about elbow; at this shoulder height the entire blade is above shell roof y=90.

limitations: Vertex check is supplemented by bounded release-column study, not claimed as continuous solid collision QA
Chest and feet require their own final art fit and deployment clearance
Skeletal support contact, mass and live easing remain Builder work
